# Third Shift

> AI automation for small businesses in Ontario, based in Kitchener-Waterloo. Third Shift builds automations that answer inquiries, chase quotes, build reports and clear supplier invoices overnight, so the team starts the day with it done. Those are the usual starting points; every build is tailored, from inventory alerts and scheduling to document drafting, onboarding and small internal tools.

- Who it's for: owner-run businesses with roughly 5 to 100 people (distributors, trades, clinics, professional services, manufacturers), met in person across Waterloo Region (Kitchener, Waterloo, Cambridge) and by video call elsewhere in Ontario.
- How it starts: a free 20-minute call, then a one-page plan with a fixed price and a delivery date.
- How it's built: people approve anything that moves money, data stays in the client's own systems, read-only access wherever possible, and every run is logged.
- Works with: Gmail, Outlook, QuickBooks, Xero, Sage, NetSuite, Excel, Google Sheets, HubSpot, Shopify, Slack, Stripe.
- Contact: thirdshift.ca@gmail.com, or the form at https://thirdshift.ca/#contact

## Pages

- [Home](https://thirdshift.ca/): services, the overnight audit, the cost calculator, how a build starts, FAQ
- [Inquiries and quotes](https://thirdshift.ca/lead-follow-up): inquiries logged and answered within minutes, open quotes followed up on a schedule
- [Reporting](https://thirdshift.ca/reporting-automation): weekly and monthly reports built overnight and checked against the source
- [Routine processes](https://thirdshift.ca/process-automation): the routine one person carries in their head, written down and run on a schedule
- [Invoices and payables](https://thirdshift.ca/invoice-automation): supplier invoices collected, matched to purchase orders and posted overnight; people approve every payment
- [Built to fit](https://thirdshift.ca/custom-automation): reorder alerts, scheduling, timesheets, quotes, onboarding, app syncing and small internal tools
- [Trades and contractors](https://thirdshift.ca/trades): quote follow-ups, crew schedules, timesheets and supplier invoices for trades businesses
- [Distributors and wholesalers](https://thirdshift.ca/distributors): order entry, supplier invoice matching, reorder alerts and collections
- [Clinics](https://thirdshift.ca/clinics): the business side of dental, physiotherapy, chiropractic and veterinary clinics; patient records stay in the clinic software
- [Professional services](https://thirdshift.ca/professional-services): document chasing, client onboarding and time-to-invoice for accounting firms, brokerages and other offices
- [Manufacturers](https://thirdshift.ca/manufacturers): purchase orders, supplier invoices, material reorders, timesheets and weekly numbers
- [Privacy](https://thirdshift.ca/privacy): what is collected through the site and how to have it deleted
